popup.title: Horseback Riding in Greater Austin
popup.subtitle: A Product Intelligence Report
popup.body: 17 public-facing horseback riding operations are profiled in this report. Types covered include guided trail ride ranches, structured English and Western lesson barns, and a luxury wellness resort equine program. Southern Trails in Manor and Miraval Austin Resort overlooking Lake Travis are two highlighted locations from the report.

popup.title: Southern Trails
popup.subtitle: 15701 Decker Lake Rd · Manor
popup.body: Just 15 minutes from downtown, Southern Trails runs highly rated guided ranch rides on a 100–120-acre property with scenic terrain. Kids' Little Dude rides and sunset trail options make it accessible to all ages. One of the closest full-service trail ride ranches to central Austin.

popup.title: Miraval Austin Resort & Spa
popup.subtitle: Northwest Austin · Lake Travis
popup.body: Overlooking Lake Travis on 220+ acres, Miraval Austin integrates horseback riding into a holistic wellness retreat. Rhythmic riding, equine-assisted self-leadership experiences, and private trail rides are available as part of all-inclusive packages. The premium end of Austin's equine scene.
